delivery_nature.statement: Implements the qualified ordered overlap task specified by the B05 journal context-resolver seam decision: extracts the monolithic Agora interaction context resolver out of main.py into an injectable pure module, deletes the duplicate private-record ACL and the interaction-router forward-wrapper ACL that duplicated it, and decouples the governance parity test from main.py globals.

manifest_hash_note: This manifest is bound by its Git blob at exact-head handoff; it does not hash itself.

composition_root_binding.pattern: Explicit top-level import of _trade_journal_allowed plus explicit read_store/extract_identity/require_read_role/bff_error/persona_directory_snapshot_fn/persona_record_tenant_id_fn/trade_journal_allowed_fn/utc_now binding; filter_private_records_fn intentionally omitted so the resolver's own filter_agora_private_records is the single ACL owner (no duplicate _agora_filter_private_records kept in main.py).

duplicate_acl_removed: agora/interaction/router.py: legacy_canonical_ref forward-wrapper duplicating decision_event/journal_entry resolution when canonical_context_ref_resolver was falsy (deleted; missing/malformed resolver result now fails closed with 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE instead of re-deriving a second, less-scoped ACL)
dead_import_cleanup: main.py: removed now-unused urllib.parse.parse_qs/unquote/urlsplit and jsonschema.Draft7Validator imports (only referenced by the deleted inline resolver body)

decision_event: strategy_id and (no version or version match) -> audience_verified True
strategy_id mismatch -> audience_verified False, row present
journal_entry_trade_episode: schema valid + persona referenced + persona tenant match + trade_journal_allowed + strategy/version match + canonical route -> audience_verified True
any of the 10 conditions false -> audience_verified False, row present
journal_entry_legacy_decision_journal: found in scope -> {row: entry, audience_verified: False} (never upgraded to True)
cross-tenant / cross-user-private -> filtered to None row
read_store missing -> {row: None, audience_verified: False}, no crash
